# West Africa Mediascape

> Interactive map and country-by-country database tracking media freedom, legal
> environment, media regulators, journalist associations, and press freedom
> alerts across 16 West African countries. Published by the Media Foundation
> for West Africa (MFWA).

## Key resources

- [Interactive map](https://mediascape.mfwa.org/): entry point, one country profile per West African country
- [Sitemap](https://mediascape.mfwa.org/sitemap.xml): full list of country profile pages
- [Media Foundation for West Africa](https://mfwa.org): parent organization, source of press freedom alerts and country reporting

## Notes

Each country page (`/country/{country-name}`) covers: legal environment, media
regulators, journalists associations, radio/TV/newspapers/online media, state-
owned media, news agency, internet freedom, and a chronological feed of press
freedom alerts filterable by year.
